death_resolver: apply available immediate aid if causally present
record death event and freeze corpse-extraction interfaces prohibited by active mechanics
principles: HP is an abstract vitality reserve, not a substitute for injury state.
Injuries persist until treated/healed by a valid mechanism.
Bleeding, shock, pain, impaired movement and consciousness are tracked separately when applicable.
Reaching 0 HP is potentially fatal and invokes the death resolver; Steal explicitly causes death when it reduces target HP to 0.
Death is persistent unless a separately established active mechanic explicitly permits reversal.
Medical treatment requires time, tools, skill, access and supplies; success cannot retroactively erase evidence of injury.
